name: Blind Cazul
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Hmm... But, of course, that is not why you have come to speak with me.

If Gan'rul has sent you to me, it must be that you are to summon a succubus, and need an object to use for enticement.

Hmm... If you trust a blind man to lead you, adventurer, then listen. In the bluffs of Orgrimmar, west of the wind rider tower, lives Zankaja. She waits for the return of her mate.

Go to her.
narrative.offerRewardText: Have you come with news of Dogran? He was to have returned days ago, and I have heard nothing...

chain.subtitle: 8 quests at level 20, 5,955 XP in all.

quests.name: Devourer of Souls
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Cazul in the Cleft of Shadow.

quests.name: News of Dogran
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gazrog at the Crossroads.

quests.name: News of Dogran
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ken'zigla at the Malaka'jin.

quests.name: Ken'zigla's Draught
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ken'zigla's Draught to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Dogran's Captivity
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ken'zigla's Draught to Dogran in the Barrens.

quests.name: Love's Gift
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Dirt-caked Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using Dogran's Pendant, summon and subdue a succubus, then return Dogran's Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
